name: DCCVT Upsampling Strategy
definition: An adaptive upsampling strategy that refines the reconstruction domain by inserting new sites based on local spacing and curvature scores to improve mesh quality.
summary: The DCCVT Upsampling Strategy is an adaptive refinement method that improves mesh quality by inserting new Voronoi sites in high-curvature regions while preserving local connectivity through tetrahedral insertion.
